notes.title: 2.02 Critical Patch
notes.notes:
AI CHASER STABILITY FIX (CRITICAL PATCH)
Replaced Event Tick with Timer-Based FakeTick in the AI Controller to reduce unnecessary CPU load and ensure consistent behavior across all hardware.

Added IsValid safety checks throughout the AI Controller and Behavior Tree Tasks:

Player references and pawn targets are now validated before access.

Prevents Accessed None crashes caused by perception of destroyed or unloaded actors.

Removed deprecated Trace by Channel damage logic, which was improperly targeting outdated damage interfaces and causing sporadic crashes on certain systems.

Cleaned up MoveTo Player and Frozen State BTTasks to fail gracefully when their targets are invalid, instead of crashing or locking behavior trees.

notes.title: The Wickie 1.2.2 - "Zelmire" Patch
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES.
============
This patch addresses serious issues when in conversation with Neville at the quay on Day 1 where a cyclical reference caused a CTD for some players.  This issue was investigated and the conversation tree modified in order to fix the dependency loop.  Thanks to player Zelmire for reporting the issue!

IN ADDITION.
===========
Streamer Octopink raised concerns that the upper walkways are difficult to navigate for some players with limited mobility or who are not good at timing jumps etc.  Because of this there are now some MAJOR changes to the Day 1 gameplay second half pipeline which will be propagated to day 2,3,4 and 5 this week after additional testing.

Change 1.
-----------
On exiting the upper engine room, you can continue to take the walkway or you can now step onto the transportation carts (Troy no doubt has a fancy name for them) which will take you on a crazy coaster ride down to the Pliades platform.  Again this is optional. 

Change 2.
-----------
If you have made your way up to the upper engine room and not put in the code correctly, rather than slowly climbing back down again, you can instead use Troy's prototype transportation device located in the room next to the generator.  This will prevent much frustration if you have not entered the code correctly.

Change 3.
-----------
SOMETIMES if you fall off a cliff and have saved and returned to a checkpoint between the upper engine room and the black gates, you may find that the engine room is shut down again meaning you have to walk back.  Not any more.  It turns out we never noticed Troy had built a large workshop where the gate lever was housed and on accessing it from the Engine Room you will find that it works just fine.

There are other changes, however that's your bob for now.

Cris R

notes.title: The Wickie - Patch 1.2.0 Changelog
notes.notes:
The Wickie - Patch 1.2.0 Changelog
A Large Feature & Fix Patch

Greetings Keepers,

Patch 1.2.0 brings significant improvements, new features, and important fixes to The Wickie. This update refines core systems, expands on visual feedback for key mechanics, and resolves several player-reported issues.

Major Changes & Features

HUD Reticule Update

[] Following player feedback, the HUD reticule has been adjusted for improved visibility.
[] The reticule now remains larger even when not hovering over an interactive item, making it easier to see in all conditions.


Checkpoint & Save System Expansion

[] The visual steampunk-inspired save system, previously used from Days 2-5, has now been implemented in Day 1 as well.
[] Instead of the previous invisible checkpoint system, players will now encounter a distinct, interactive save area that reacts when activated.
 A small animated circle will now appear in the lower-right corner to indicate when a save is successfully registered.


Fixes & Gameplay Improvements

Storeroom Security

 The storeroom at the Quay has been relocked to prevent unintended access.


Sailor Conversations Repaired

[] Certain conversations among sailors previously referenced incorrect names—these have now been corrected.
[] The two sailors talking on Gondola Island now play the appropriate dialogue, restoring narrative consistency.


Improved Water Exit on Gondola Island

 Players who fall into the water upon first arriving at Gondola Island will now find it much easier to exit, thanks to a newly added stairway.


New Conversations Added for Clarity

 Neil at the Engine Rooms now has additional dialogue to better explain the purpose of the steampunk save system and how it functions.


Keybinding System Fixed & Fully Functional

[] Keybinding was previously non-functional—this has now been completely resolved.
[] Players can now fully customize their key and gamepad bindings for movement and interactions.


New Mouse & Controller Customization Options

[] Players can now adjust controller sensitivity for both mouse and gamepad via the Pause Menu.
[] Mouse inversion is now fully supported, providing more options for player preference.


Versioning & Acknowledgments

Due to the scale of this release, the game version has moved from 1.1.4 to 1.2.0.

Special thanks to Tony and Octopink for reporting these issues—your feedback has been invaluable in improving the experience for all players!

notes.title: Version 0.8.3 - Closed Beta Version Information (possible spoilers)
notes.notes:
Version 0.8.3 - Patch Notes

Release Date: June 2024

Highlights:

Day 1 & Day 2 Completion: These levels are now fully playable, providing a solid foundation for new and returning players.
Day 3, 4, and 5: These levels are near completion with minor tweaks and narrative elements for NPCs pending, and anticipated to be finalized within two months.
New Observatory Area: The under-observatory areas, including labs and study zones for Troy's projects, offer a vast pipeline passageway providing an alternate route through the island, bypassing the Smugglers Run section.
Dialogue & Humor: New dialogue options enhance the storyline with humour, particularly through interactions with Peter De Bole and the evolving character of Troy Malin.
Engine Upgrade: Upgraded the game engine from Unreal Engine 5.2.1 to Unreal Engine 5.4.1, significantly enhancing visual fidelity, performance, and stability.
Technical Improvements:

DLSS Update: Integrated and optimized DLSS, delivering an average of 80FPS on high detail at 1080p and stable performance at 4k, although not fully optimized.
Sound Adjustments: Ambient sounds have been refined to enrich the game’s atmosphere.
Engine Upgrade: The game has been upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.4.1, moving from 5.2.1. Originally, the game started development on Unreal Engine 4.11.0.
Gameplay Enhancements:

Easter Eggs & Hidden Items: Added new easter eggs and hidden items to discover, increasing engagement and replayability.
Cosmetic Upgrades: Essential visual enhancements have been implemented to elevate the overall gaming experience.
Narrative Progress:

Character Development: Continued development of Troy Malin’s character, adding depth and humor to the narrative.
Day 3 Narrative: The narrative for Day 3 involves Bill investigating a missing necklace with esoteric powers, critical to the Marsh family's operations.
Upcoming Features:

Radio Station for Day 2: Pending further development, expected to be integrated after a dedicated weekend of work.

notes.title: Version 0.8.2.4 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Version 0.8.2.4 - Patch Notes

Release Date: Sunday, May 19th, 2024

Patch Highlights:

Critical enhancements to the quest system and save/load functionality for improved playability.
Details:

Quest System Overhaul:

The quest system now provides end-to-end guidance for players from the start to the end of each day, ensuring clear objectives and smoother progression.
Quests are now integrated with the overall save system, allowing players to save and load their progress without losing active or completed quests. This ensures continuity and prevents the loss of progress.
Save/Load Functionality:

Although marked for future upgrades, the current save and load system is now functional and reliable, supporting the newly integrated quest system.
Players can now save their game at any point and resume from where they left off, with all quest data intact.
Quest Tracking for Keyboard Users:

For keyboard users, pressing the / key on the numpad will bring up a list of active and completed quests.
This feature is a temporary solution for quest tracking, with plans for easier access and more intuitive UI in the next save/load system update.
Tester Notes:

This update is critical for enhancing playability and ensuring players know their objectives and how to achieve them.
Feedback on the functionality of the quest system and the save/load integration is crucial. Please report any issues or suggestions for improvement.

notes.title: 0.8.2.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Version 0.8.2.3 - Patch Notes

Release Date: Wednesday, May 15th, 2024

Patch Highlights:

Enhanced NPC positioning to eliminate clipping issues.
Spelling corrections in dialogue to improve narrative quality.
Accessibility improvements and aesthetic enhancements across various game locations.
Details:

NPC Position Adjustments:

Fixed issues where various NPCs were either floating or embedded in the ground, ensuring all characters interact with the environment realistically.
Dialogue Improvements:

Corrected spelling errors across multiple dialogue scripts, enhancing clarity and immersion in the game's storytelling.
Gondola Island Gantryway:

Fixed the rear gantryway and removed a large obstacle that hindered access to the secret teleport area.
Secret Teleport Area:

Introduced a key accessible to players upon completing a side quest on Gondola Island. The teleport area door is now locked, adding a layer of challenge and intrigue.
Visual Enhancements:

Added new foliage on the long stairs at Pandora's Rock island to enhance visual appeal.
Erected new structures next to the esoteric gateway on Pandora's Rock, integrating it more seamlessly with the surrounding environment and addressing gaps in the scenery.
Spider Mechanic Adjustments:

Repositioned the spider in the engine room tunnels to address previous functionality issues.
Simplified the floor of the spider chamber and filled in holes to prevent player and NPC mishaps.
Tutorial Puzzle Feedback:

The tutorial puzzle involving moving a skull into a waste basket now provides player feedback upon completion, indicating that an NPC area door is unlocked.
Tester Feedback Request:

We particularly value feedback on the new positioning of the spider and the functionality of the secret teleport area. Please report any irregularities or suggestions for further refinements.

notes.title: The Wickie Pre-Release 0.8 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Dear Future Players,

I am REALLY happy to be able to tell you that I have achieved a significant milestone as of today.  The Wickie is now at 0.8.0 for its version, which may not mean a lot to the layman out there, however it marks a massive step in The Wickie : Shadows Over Islolation's march towards a release this year.  While it may sound technical as a number, it represents a major leap from the early days, bringing me closer to delivering a complete gaming experience.  

Early demonstrations of The Wickie four years ago relied only on a few items and areas, meaning t hat while I was in early test, I was only using an early version of the Engine Rooms, Lighthouse, Lighthouse Station, shed, Village and Standing Stones for development.  Since then these areas were completely removed and revised and additional areas were added en masse to bring this island in the Western Outer Hebrides to life!

These include but are not limited to

There are all areas not buildings, explorable and large and make up a huge part of the game too.  The completion of the 0.7.X versions means I am now happy with the world sandbox that you have to explore and play in and that it is time to make sure that you have fun doing so!

At the moment the focus of the 8.0+ releases is on quest management and dialogue which is there but needs a but of tightening and tuning.  Future focus is also on splitting the days into their own containers to make gameplay more interesting and exciting!

Ideas tried and abandoned for being silly (aww) are;

notes.title: The Wickie Update 0.7.4
notes.notes:
The Wickie Update 0.7.4

Greetings,

We are pleased to announce the release of Update 0.7.4 for "The Wickie". This update marks significant advancements in game content, optimization, and player interaction mechanics. Please find the details of the changes included in this patch below.

New Content:

Day 4 Expansion: The introduction of Day 4 includes fully explorable new areas complete with unique environmental storytelling elements, engaging puzzles, and lore-rich scenarios. Players can now uncover the mysteries of the Lower Broch Fortifications, the Vast (non) Submerged Daolithc area, Valve Caracalla, and more.

Entity Development: We have integrated a new cosmic entity, Daolithc, into the game narrative. Daolithc offers a complex character design aligned with the overarching cosmic horror theme, presenting both a visual and narrative enhancement to the game world.

Optimizations:

Performance Enhancements: Significant optimizations have been implemented to improve game speed and maintain consistent frame rates across all supported hardware, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.
Gameplay Improvements:

NPC Interaction: We have revisited the NPC interaction system, reverting to the 'click to interact' method to provide a more intuitive and responsive player experience.
Upcoming Work:

Interaction System Update: Later this week, we plan to roll out further improvements to the NPC interaction system to address current issues and enhance overall game responsiveness.
We are dedicated to continuously improving "The Wickie" and appreciate your feedback and support. Thank you for joining us on this eerie adventure.

notes.title: The Wickie 0.7 Update - A Glimpse into Pandora's Rock
notes.notes:
Press Release: The Wickie 0.7  - A Journey Through Time, Mystery, and Innovation

[Summary]

"The Wickie," a visually stunning and deeply immersive adventure game, is slated for release in April 2024. This marks the end of a remarkable four-year development journey by Cris Robson, a passionate and dedicated game developer. Built on Unreal Engine 5.2.3, the game employs groundbreaking technologies like Lumen and Nanite to deliver an unmatched level of realism and visual fidelity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/2f5ec9dd6a79ed7e77d7a8aecb6aa1cbf3650cb7.png

[Body]

In "The Wickie," players are transported to Pandora's Rock, a mysterious island filled with secrets, supernatural occurrences, and an incredibly rich environment. The game spans an intense five days of in-game time, packed with complex missions and captivating storylines.

The latest 0.7 beta release is the most robust yet, featuring state-of-the-art global illumination and detailed environments for an immersive gaming experience. Smooth gameplay is guaranteed on platforms like Steamdeck, although 4K resolution demands a more robust system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/320ec884ae8061cf81b128b3a6441d332a69f566.png

Unique to "The Wickie" is its commitment to free lifetime updates, allowing the game to evolve and grow based on player interactions. This player-centric development approach sets the game apart from traditional DLC models.

The game's narrative is a rich tapestry of history, myth, and technology, offering players a diverse and engaging experience. From encountering ghosts and mysterious creatures to solving intricate puzzles, "The Wickie" promises a journey full of discovery and intrigue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/946b42bbcf255696a9687575890d4479ae39ec23.png

The game world is a masterpiece of design, with a new water system that produces realistic waves and a beautifully crafted natural landscape. Key features include the lighthouse keeper mini-game, which adds a layer of complexity and realism to the gameplay.

[About the Developer]

"The Wickie" is the brainchild of Cris Robson, a 52-year-old game developer with Autism and Cerebral Palsy. Cris's journey in game development is a story of passion, resilience, and creativity. Despite facing challenges, his commitment to bringing "The Wickie" to life has been unwavering. This project is more than a game; it's a reflection of Cris's dedication to his craft and his desire to create an experience that resonates with players on multiple levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/b0590ed8ec977a0bc10ed0d55f90d803526ec20c.png

Cris's approach to game development is deeply personal, infusing "The Wickie" with a unique perspective that enriches the gaming experience. His journey is an inspiring testament to the power of determination and the endless possibilities within the realm of independent game development.

notes.title: Pre-Release Feb Update (Major) now live for testers.
notes.notes:
The Wickie: Latest Release Notes Feb 14th Version Now Available for Playtesting

Gamers and adventure enthusiasts alike can now experience the latest version of The Wickie, which is available for playtesting. This version includes new experimental features that have yet to be fully documented.

In an effort to streamline gameplay, the option to play guitar has been removed from the game. The developers found that it added little to the game and did not contribute to the overall story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/ac89ceea63f8c2f10405147bbfcce4aa8cf3862f.png

However, players can still discover guitar-playing areas in the game, hidden as Easter eggs for those who seek them out.

The game's standard levels include Day 1 Introduction, Day 1, Dreams 1, NES 1, Day 2, and Books. Some of the books in the game are readable, and players can pick them up and store them, dropping them as needed. Players can only carry one book at a time, so strategic decision-making is required.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/c379fe71371fd25369fea2f832d098754ab09bf4.png

The game encourages players to explore and follow clues, but be wary of pitfalls and traps along the way. The island changes and morphs throughout the game, reflecting the mental state of the main character.

As the game is still under development, players can expect to encounter bugs or glitches, which will be addressed through regular patches and updates.

The Wickie offers an immersive and challenging gaming experience that will test players' wits and perseverance. Are you brave enough to explore the secrets of the island? Play The Wickie and find out!

notes.title: The Wickie Public Demo Version 2 is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Originally released mid June 2021, The Wickie Demo version 1 was a fun journey fron Goldola Island through to Pandora's Rock with the aim of finding Captain Malin so that you can report for duty as a probationary lighthouse keeper.  

The new demo releases right now, and with this demo comes a lot of new features that finally made it into the game as well as a lot more content for you to discover and try out for yourself.  Some of the new content is available right now, with some bonus material to be released into the live version of the demo over the next few weeks.  

New Things.
1.  Find them yourself.  That's kind of the point.

Trivia and Interesting Things

Did you try the original version 0.1? That was the only version where you could actually ride The Wanderer, back before Gondola Island was created to act as a platform into Pandora's Island.  All tthe puzzles took place upon the ship and the demo ended when you got to the main island before the boat docked.  It had full narration, which was cut because honestly I was sick of the sound of my own voice.  Thank god for Rob Sharp (Capt Malin), at least he knows how to talk properly!

The lighthouse was originally a tower lighthouse.  Tower lighthouses are the ones that stand on their own without an island and the game was going to explore the idea of being a lighthouse keeper more as a simulation.
